name: @angel/electron
description: Angel-Ai — invisible real-time AI assistant desktop app

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync('bundle',{recursive:true,force:true});" && tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('dist/apps/electron/src','bundle',{recursive:true,dereference:true});" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('bundle/server',{recursive:true});" && node "../../node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild" "../../apps/server/dist/apps/server/src/index.js" --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --outfile="bundle/server/index.js" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('../../apps/web/out','bundle/web/out',{recursive:true,dereference:true});" && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync('bundle',{recursive:true,force:true});" && tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('dist/apps/electron/src','bundle',{recursive:true,dereference:true});" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('bundle/server',{recursive:true});" && node "../../node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild" "../../apps/server/dist/apps/server/src/index.js" --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --outfile="bundle/server/index.js" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('../../apps/web/out','bundle/web/out',{recursive:true,dereference:true});" && electron-builder --mac
